bug_info.bug_desc: The obsolete assertion treats a grant observed while the LSU is in WAIT_RVALID as requiring response valid in the same cycle. In this state the original request has already been granted and the response may arrive later, so valid memory-interface timing can trigger a false assertion failure.
bug_info.fix_hint: Check that a response-valid event occurs only while the LSU is in a state that expects a response, without requiring request grant and response valid to coincide in the same cycle.
